name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-float-as-byte-negative-255-p.bal
reason: The case asserts a runtime panic when casting the negative float -255.0 to byte. Type casts, numeric literals, unary minus, local declarations and function calls with required parameters are supported, and no restriction excludes out-of-range numeric casts or their panic behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected failure at the cast; the helper receives a float parameter so the assertion concerns runtime conversion.
